question: Sahitya Akademi Award winner Maya Khutegaonkar is a renowned _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lavani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lavani** is a traditional dance form of **Maharashtra**, India.
 
• It is noted for its powerful rhythm and has contributed substantially to the development of Marathi folk theatre.
 
• The word 'Lavani' is derived from the word 'Lavanya' which means beauty.
 
• Lavani is a combination of traditional song and dance, which is performed to the beats of Dholki, a percussion instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihu**

 
 
• Bihu is an indigenous folk dance from the Indian state of Assam.
 
• It is performed during the Bihu festival and is characterized by brisk dance steps, and rapid hand movements, and is traditionally danced by young men and women.
 
• Bihu is associated with agriculture and marks the Assamese New Year.
 
 
 
• **Suggie**
 
 
• Suggie is not a known traditional dance form in India.
 
 
 
• **Jhumar**
 
 
• Jhumar is a traditional folk dance form from the Indian states of Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan.
 
• It is performed during harvest season and at weddings and other festive occasions.
 
• The dance is characterized by the graceful movements of the dancers and the rhythmic clapping.
